title: X-Piratez HD launcher
status.upToDate: Latest version installed, all files in place.
status.cancelled: Cancelled. The download will resume next time.
status.notGameDir: No game here: common, user and OpenXcomEx.exe are required.

modified.title: Files changed by you
modified.text: These files differ from what the launcher installed. Checked files will be replaced (old copies kept in the backup), the rest stay as they are until the next release.
rollback.confirm: Return files to the version before the last update?
self.required: This release needs launcher {0} or newer.
self.readonly: The launcher folder is read-only: move the launcher to a folder of your own.
report.title: Report a problem
report.paused: The game is paused while this window is open. Close it and the game continues from the same moment.
report.field.title: Summary, one line
report.consent: The log and the save are sent only when ticked. Paths with your user name and e-mail addresses are removed from the log before sending.
report.cancelConfirm: Delete this report together with its screenshot?
report.required: Fill in the summary and the description.
report.noPortal: The support site address is not set. The report is saved; send it later from the launcher.
report.queued: The site is unreachable. The report is queued - send it later with the Reports button in the launcher, or retry now.
report.queuedBefore: This report is queued: the site was unreachable last time.
report.sentHint: Follow the reply and add details via the link. The link is kept in the launcher's report list.
report.err.file_too_large: the file is larger than the site accepts
report.err.ticket_files_too_large: the report already has too many files
report.err.file_type_not_allowed: the site does not accept this file type
report.err.consent_required: consent to send files is required

support.title: Support
support.hint: The game is free and will stay free. If you enjoy it, you can thank its authors.
support.modNote: the author of X-Piratez: the mod is almost entirely one person's work
support.hdNote: the new graphics, the launcher and the support site
reports.hint: Reports made with F8 in the game. Unsent ones never go by themselves: send them with the Send button when the site is reachable.
reports.deleteConfirm: Delete the report from disk? If it was sent, it stays on the site.
report.saveSnapshot: This game as it is now ({0})

home.notInstalled: The launcher has not recorded a game version yet
main.installHint: The launcher downloads the mod and sets the game up itself
main.haveGame: The game is already installed - point to its folder
setup.title: Installing the game
setup.langHint: Russian ticks the RU patch and Russian names at once.
setup.langRestart: The launcher itself switches language after a restart.
setup.dirHint: An empty folder, or the folder the game is already in. It needs a few gigabytes.
setup.dirNotEmpty: This folder already holds something that is not the game. Choose an empty one.
setup.ufoHint: X-Piratez needs the files of the original UFO: Enemy Unknown (X-COM: UFO Defense). We do not give them out: the launcher copies them from your Steam or GOG copy.
setup.ufoInPlace: The UFO files are already in the game folder.
setup.ufoFound: Found - where to take them from:
setup.ufoNone: The original game is not on this computer. Buy and install it - the launcher notices by itself, no need to close this window.
setup.ufoMissing: This folder lacks the files needed: {0}
setup.partsHint: Grey lines cannot be installed - the reason is next to them.
setup.loading: Asking the server what the release holds…
setup.adult: "{0}" is for adults only. Are you 18 or older?
setup.doneText: The game {0} is installed and set up.
setup.doneChanges:
The launcher set the game up:
{0}
pc.modsKept: Mods left as you set them in the game
pc.opt.oxceHdMode.1: HD sprites: the HD mod's pictures
pc.opt.oxceHdMode.2: HD sprites: the HD mod's pictures, the rest smoothed
pc.opt.oxceHdUiSkin.1: Interface look: the mod's colours with soft gradients
pc.opt.oxceHdUiFont.0: Interface font: the game's own, smoothed
setup.ownHint: You put these mods into user\mods yourself. The launcher neither downloads nor removes them. Their compatibility with our build was never checked: if the game acts strangely, switch them off first. Switch them on and off in the game's own Mods menu.
setup.ownOtherMaster: made for {0}: the game will not switch it on with this master mod
settings.modsHint: Which mods are installed — "Game components". Which are on and in what order — the Mods menu in the game itself: the launcher sees that you changed the list and leaves it alone before a start.
settings.resetConfirm: Bring back the mods, their order and the recommended options as we set them up for this mod? Mods you added yourself stay, on or off as you left them.
settings.resetNothing: We have no settings of our own for this mod — the game starts as it is.
builds.hint: The green one is the build "Play" starts; click another to pick it. The buttons act on the green one. A build is a set of mods with its own game settings. The mods sit in one folder for all builds; builds of the same mod share saves. While the game runs, builds cannot be changed.
builds.newName: Name of the new build. Mods and settings are the recommended ones, as after installing.
builds.copyName: Name of the copy. It gets all settings of the build "{0}".
builds.deleteConfirm: Delete the build "{0}"? Mods stay where they are, and so do saves. The build's settings go to launcher\backup\builds and can be put back.
builds.onlyOne: This is the only build: it cannot be deleted.
builds.running: The game is running: builds can be changed after you quit it.
main.chooseHint: The folder with openxcom_hd.exe, common and user
main.runningUpdate: The update installs after you quit the game
notice.needsInfo: The team answered report {0} and needs details
settings.languageRestart: The language changes after the launcher restarts.
settings.installedNone: No game version recorded yet: an update will install every file.
settings.repairHint: Rechecks every game file and downloads damaged ones again. Takes a few minutes.
settings.rollbackHint: Returns the files to the version before the last update. Asks first.
report.optional: step by step, if you know
review.title: Check the art
review.hint: On the left is what the game draws without the pack, on the right what it draws with it. A floor is shown as a field of map cells: one tile can look fine while the field of it is a lattice. Marks stay on this machine until you send them.
review.caption: frame {0} · colour off by {1} · {2}
review.note: What is wrong with this frame, in your own words. Optional.
review.keys: Arrows to page, 1 2 3 for a verdict, 0 to clear, Q W E R T Y for the reasons. Esc leaves the description box back to the arrows.
review.saved: Saved to {0}. To send straight to the site, link the launcher to an account in the settings.
review.sent: Sent: {0} sets, {1} pictures. See it on the site, "Roadmap".
review.sendFailed: Could not send: {0}. The marks are still here — try again later.
review.nothing: Nothing to send yet: give at least one frame a verdict.
review.loaded: Frames to check: {0}. Skipped: {1} the game never draws, {2} missing from the pack.
review.noGame: No game folder chosen — pick it in the settings.
review.noPack: No HD packs in this installation: nothing to check.
account.title: Account
account.none: This launcher is not linked to anybody.
account.hint: Linking opens voice rooms, and art verdicts go in your name. No password is typed into the launcher: press the button, the launcher opens the site with the code filled in - sign in there (or sign up) and confirm.
link.strip: To use everything the launcher can do, link it to your account on the site - press "Link the launcher" on the right or in Settings. No password needed.
link.waiting: The site is open with code {0}: sign in there (or sign up) and press Link. The launcher links itself.
account.waiting: Waiting for the site to confirm...
account.codeHint: The site is open with this code: sign in there and confirm it. If the page did not open, press Open the site. The code lives ten minutes.
account.unlinkHint: Unlinking takes the key off this machine. Verdicts already sent stay.
account.expired: Nobody confirmed the code - take a new one.
account.revoked: The link was taken away on the site. Link again to go on.
account.offline: The site does not answer. Try later.
voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: Voice rooms for your crew: create a room, invite friends on the site and talk while you play.
voice.unlinked: Voice works under your account on the site. Link the launcher in Settings - no password needed.
voice.created: Room "{0}" is created. Invite friends on the site.
voice.friendsSite: Friends and invitations on the site
voice.noneMine: No rooms of your own yet.
voice.linkMissing: There is no such room, or you have no access to it.
voice.linkWhileIn: You are in a room already. Leave it to go to the room of the link.
voice.state.banned: you are banned in this room
voice.state.account_banned: voice is forbidden for your account
voice.state.not_friends: you are no longer friends with the owner
voice.state.device_unknown: The launcher is no longer linked to your account. Link it again in Settings.
voice.state.room_full: The room is full. Try later.
voice.away.removed: The owner took you out of the room.
voice.away.duplicate: You joined this room from another computer.
voice.away.other: The server closed the connection to the room.
voice.busy: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
voice.unavailable: Voice is unavailable on the server right now. Try later.
voice.err.limit_rooms: You cannot create more rooms: delete one of yours on the site.
voice.err.title_invalid: The name does not fit: 1 to 80 characters.
voice.err.owner_only: Only the room's owner can do this.
voice.err.owner_target: The owner cannot be removed or banned.
voice.err.user_not_found: There is no such person on the site.
voice.err.closed_by_staff: The room was closed by the staff.
voice.conn.unavailable: Voice is unavailable on the server right now, trying again…
voice.conn.device: The sound stopped, reopening the device ({0} s)…
voice.cantSpeak: The owner does not let you speak in this room: nobody hears you.
voice.micMissing: The microphone did not open: nobody hears you. Looking for it…
voice.micMissingCheck: The microphone did not open. Check that it is plugged in and allowed in the Windows settings.
voice.mutePrompt: Forbid {0} to speak in the room. A reason, if you like:
voice.kickPrompt: Remove {0} from the room. A reason, if you like:
voice.banPrompt: Ban {0} in the room. A reason, if you like:
voice.nextEntry: A new device works from the next time you join a room.
voice.checkHint: Say something: the bar should move. The sound is not sent anywhere.
voice.checkBusy: No test needed in a room: the microphone level is shown above.
voice.assignWait: Press a key or a side mouse button… (Esc - cancel)
voice.conflict: The game uses this key ({0}): the game gets the press too.
voice.hookFailed: Could not watch the key: push to talk does not work. Switch to "Microphone always on".
